children: Alset's revenue fell 6% year over year, while net income rose compared with the prior-year quarter, supported by higher other income, including a $6.1 million gain on ESYN deconsolidation and increased unrealized gains on related-party securities.
¹ Reported as “Total Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Common Stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Net Income (Loss) Per Share - Basic and Diluted”.
: Rental revenue increased 3% to $716,614; the company expects growth as it acquires and rents more houses.
: Revenue from other businesses declined 27% to $222,326, generated by Korean, Singaporean and Chinese café shops and restaurants.
: Rose to $118,707 from $81,269 as cost of sales decreased, primarily due to lower F&B business costs.
: The company lost control of ESYN on August 10 and recognized a $6.1 million gain.
